_comment_address: The node's etherbase: every block reward lands here. For payouts the node keystore must hold this key (gvbc account import) and --http.api must include personal.

rewardRecipients._comment: Pool fee percentages by address, e.g. "0xFeeAddress": 0.5

_comment_daemons: geth-family node. Easiest: expose the miner API (--http.api eth,net,web3,miner,personal) and NAMP engages sealing itself; or run the node with --mine --miner.threads=0 --miner.etherbase <address>. See docs/ethash.md.

paymentProcessing._comment_paymentMode: prop (round shares) | solo (finder takes all) | pplns (last-N window, n x block difficulty)
paymentProcessing._comment_minConf: Confirmations before a block matures. 120 at 12s blocks is ~24 minutes.
paymentProcessing._comment_blockReward: Only used when the coin definition has no blockRewardSchedule (coins/virbicoin.json carries the full VirBiCoin schedule).
paymentProcessing._comment_accountPassword: Keystore password for personal_unlockAccount before each payout run.

_comment_ports: diff is the share difficulty in hashes (ethash difficulty 1 = 1 hash). Size fixed-diff ports at rig hashrate x target seconds per share: a 60 MH/s GPU at ~4s/share wants ~250000000. varDiff retargets each miner toward targetTime seconds per share within [minDiff, maxDiff].

8002._comment: Fixed high-difficulty port for large rigs / NiceHash-style renters.

_comment_banning: Same policy as the Bitcoin-family stratum: after checkThreshold shares, an IP whose invalid share percentage exceeds invalidPercent is banned for `time` seconds.
